hero.title: About Rifqy
hero.tagline: AI Engineer · Gen AI Engineer · Web App Developer
hero.summary: I write this story myself: an AI engineer weaving LLM agents, generative strategy, and web experiences that stay human. Everything starts by listening—understanding the wonder, the tension, and the room to grow together.

philosophy.heading: Philosophy & Vision
paragraphs: Freedom of Intelligence is more than a mantra—it is the invitation I give myself before every build. Intelligence should move freely, touch people with empathy, and return with something useful.
"Ad astra abyssosque" keeps the compass steady: dive to the depths, reach for the stars, and bring back work that feels close, caring, and well documented.
secondary: I believe the future belongs to those who dare to step first while keeping the process disciplined. Every collaboration starts with deep research, shared values, and a transparent working language. My focus is on AI engineering and web delivery that are designed in measured iterations, tested, and documented so teams feel safe to experiment.

My vision is to build an ecosystem of AI innovation and responsible automation while staying grounded in automotive, property, and air-mobility sectors. I want AI to help teams ship products, build accountable automation, and elevate software and web experiences crafted locally.

story.heading: Story & Mission
paragraphs: I grew up obsessed with knowledge. Freedom of Intelligence became my personal mantra—intelligence that can travel freely, touch people, communities, and the universe. "Ad astra abyssosque" reminds me to dive deep, fly far, and return with creations that matter.

I start every collaboration with empathy. I listen to the story, map the system, and craft LLM agents, generative pipelines, and web apps that protect privacy. When there are gaps, I fill them with documentation, evaluation, and warm guidance so everyone feels supported.

Education with real impact fuels this journey. I want to share tools and narratives that anyone can understand—founders experimenting with AI, students who need a bridge, teams searching for clarity. By bringing intelligence into AI, web, and frontier explorations, this personal brand becomes a living library you can revisit anytime.
